headline: Getmantsev named criteria by which the tax service should select small companies for audits
summary: Ukraine's tax chief set out criteria for selecting small companies for audits. The article notes that 122 private firms earned over UAH 1 billion in at least one of 2024–2025 with only 1 to 3 employees.
why: Tax audit criteria affect compliance risk for small and private firms, and shape the government's revenue collection approach.
